name: @kavach/api
description: Python backend (uv). These scripts let `pnpm dev` and turbo start it with the web apps.

scripts.dev:offline: BRAIN_PROVIDER=fake BAND_ENABLED=false TARGET_MODEL=fake TARGET_URL=inprocess FAKE_DELAY_S=1 uv run uvicorn kavach.api.app:app --port 8000
scripts.lint: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
